title: The Return v8 (deep-study rules: cinematic body, steady bed, 4-bar theme, Carnatic instrument)
maker: ElevenLabs Music API on the owner's paid plan

request.prompt: Dark modern Tamil mass-hero film score, cinematic, not EDM or DJ music. 108 BPM in a heavy half-time swagger, C sharp minor with menacing chromatic half-step bends, in the mood of Carnatic Raga Shanmukhapriya. Body: a full, steady low brass section and low strings holding dark sustained chords from start to finish, a deep steady sub bass that never cuts out, and a dark synth bass only doubling the low end as colour. Carnatic instruments clearly audible: a mridangam playing a syncopated groove with small gaps before the beat, a veena carrying the main theme with fast ornamented gamaka runs, and a venu bamboo flute adding fast stepwise runs. One clear 4-bar heroic theme that returns again and again, answered by the brass. Vocals: only deep male crowd chants and wordless shouts like 'hey!' and 'ho!' between phrases, no lyrics, no singer. Arrangement: no intro, start full on beat one; energy only grows by adding layers every 8 bars, never by cutting layers; no side-chain pumping, no EDM drops, no on-off bass, no build-and-drop. 0-8 s: full entry with brass, strings, sub bass, mridangam groove and the veena theme. 8-24 s: theme returns, brass answers, chants between phrases. 24-40 s: add higher strings, bigger drums and fast flute runs. 40-52 s: biggest point with everything and the full chant. 52-60 s: the theme one last time, ending on one huge hit. Clear, tonal, punchy cinematic mix, very loud and steady; no white-noise sweeps, no distorted noise layers, no harsh fuzz, no even sixteenth-note hi-hat rolls.

brief.raga: Shanmukhapriya (Carnatic melakarta 56): fierce and heroic, minor colour with a raised 4th (prati madhyamam). The hero motif is 4 notes: Sa, Ri, Ga (minor), then a leap to the raised Ma, held.
brief.lead: nadaswaram (the hero's voice), with solo cello and bansuri for memory
cues: 0-8 s  Full cinematic entry on beat one: low brass and low strings on a dark sustained chord, steady sub bass, mridangam groove, the 4-bar theme on veena
8-24 s  Theme returns every 4 bars, brass answers; a dark synth bass doubles the low end (colour only); deep male crowd chants between phrases
24-40 s  Add layers (no cuts): higher strings, bigger drums, venu flute fast runs over the theme
40-52 s  Biggest point: everything plus the full crowd chant, theme on brass and veena together
52-60 s  Theme one last time, ending on one huge hit
brief.notes: Built on music-scoring.md §8 + §8b. Jithesh on v7: pattern right but noise/DJ-like; always one Carnatic instrument.
brief.sound: cinematic orchestra body + mridangam, veena and venu; synths only as colour; clear, tonal, steady, no pumping, no noise

story: A hero walks back into his city after many years away. The city half-remembers him; then the whole street knows he is back.
